Private network, a network local to the Bare Metal Solution environment.

LogicalNetworkInterface.description: Each logical network interface is effectively a network and IP pair.

name.description: The name of the VRF.

qosPolicy.description: The QOS policy applied to this VRF. The value is only meaningful when all the vlan attachments have the same QoS. This field should not be used for new integrations, use vlan attachment level qos instead. The field is left for backward-compatibility.

vlanAttachments.description: The list of VLAN attachments for the VRF.

sizeGb.description: The requested size of each LUN, in GB.

id.description: Output only. An identifier for the snapshot, generated by the backend.

name.description: The name of the snapshot.

storageVolume.description: Output only. The name of the volume which this snapshot belongs to.

enumDescriptions: Snapshot was taken manually by user.
Snapshot was taken automatically as a part of a snapshot schedule.
type.description: Output only. The type of the snapshot which indicates whether it was scheduled or manual/ad-hoc.

createTime.description: Output only. The creation time of the snapshot.

VolumeSnapshot.description: A snapshot of a volume. Only boot volumes can have snapshots.

UserAccount.description: User account provisioned for the customer.

kmsKeyVersion.description: KMS CryptoKey Version used to encrypt the password.

newVolumeId.description: Required. The new `id` of the volume.

RenameVolumeRequest.description: Message requesting rename of a server.

locations.description: A list of locations that matches the specified filter in the request.

Empty.description: A generic empty message that you can re-use to avoid defining duplicated empty messages in your APIs. A typical example is to use it as the request or the response type of an API method. For instance: service Foo { rpc Bar(google.protobuf.Empty) returns (google.protobuf.Empty); }

enumDescriptions: ProvisioningConfig is a draft and can be freely modified.
ProvisioningConfig was already submitted and cannot be modified.
ProvisioningConfig was in the provisioning state. Initially this state comes from the work order table in big query when SNOW is used. Later this field can be set by the work order API.
ProvisioningConfig was provisioned, meaning the resources exist.
ProvisioningConfig was validated. A validation tool will be run to set this state.
The request is submitted for provisioning, with error return.

cloudConsoleUri.description: Output only. URI to Cloud Console UI view of this provisioning config.

statusMessage.description: Optional status messages associated with the FAILED state.

handoverServiceAccount.description: A service account to enable customers to access instance credentials upon handover.

ticketId.description: A generated ticket id to track provisioning request.

customId.description: Optional. The user-defined identifier of the provisioning config.

pod.description: Optional. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Instance can be connected to the assets (networks, volumes, nfsshares) allocated in the same pod only.

location.description: Optional. Location name of this ProvisioningConfig. It is optional only for Intake UI transition period.

vpcScEnabled.description: If true, VPC SC is enabled for the cluster.

email.description: Email provided to send a confirmation with provisioning config to. Deprecated in favour of email field in request messages.

name.description: Output only. The system-generated name of the provisioning config. This follows the UUID format.

reservedSpaceRemainingGib.description: The amount, in GiB, of available space in this storage volume's reserved snapshot space.

reservedSpaceGib.description: The space on this storage volume reserved for snapshots, shown in GiB.

reservedSpaceUsedPercent.description: The percent of snapshot space on this storage volume actually being used by the snapshot copies. This value might be higher than 100% if the snapshot copies have overflowed into the data portion of the storage volume.

reservedSpacePercent.description: Percent of the total Volume size reserved for snapshot copies. Enabling snapshots requires reserving 20% or more of the storage volume space for snapshots. Maximum reserved space for snapshots is 40%. Setting this field will effectively set snapshot_enabled to true.

SnapshotReservationDetail.description: Details about snapshot space reservation and usage on the storage volume.

Location.description: A resource that represents a Google Cloud location.

name.description: Resource name for the location, which may vary between implementations. For example: `"projects/example-project/locations/us-east1"`

labels.description: Cross-service attributes for the location. For example {"cloud.googleapis.com/region": "us-east1"}

displayName.description: The friendly name for this location, typically a nearby city name. For example, "Tokyo".

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

metadata.description: Service-specific metadata. For example the available capacity at the given location.

locationId.description: The canonical id for this location. For example: `"us-east1"`.

NetworkUsage.description: Network with all used IP addresses.

usedIps.description: All used IP addresses in this network.

bandwidthGbps.description: The bandwidth permitted by the QOS policy, in gbps.

nfsShareId.description: Output only. An identifier for the NFS share, generated by the backend. This field will be deprecated in the future, use `id` instead.

volume.description: Output only. The underlying volume of the share. Created automatically during provisioning.

storageType.description: Immutable. The storage type of the underlying volume.
enumDescriptions: The storage type for this volume is unknown.
The storage type for this volume is SSD.
This storage type for this volume is HDD.

pod.description: Immutable. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. NFSShare can only be connected to the assets (networks, instances) allocated in the same pod.

id.description: Output only. An identifier for the NFS share, generated by the backend. This is the same value as nfs_share_id and will replace it in the future.

name.description: Immutable. The name of the NFS share.

state.description: Output only. The state of the NFS share.
enumDescriptions: The share is in an unknown state.
The NFS Share is being created.
The NFS Share is being updated.
The NFS Share has been requested to be deleted.

Status.description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the google.rpc.Status.details field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

ListInstancesResponse.description: Response message for the list of servers.

nextPageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results from the server.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

machineId.description: Either a single machine, identified by an ID, or a comma-separated list of machine IDs.

allowDev.description: Allow dev flag in NfsShare AllowedClientsRequest.

noRootSquash.description: Disable root squashing, which is a feature of NFS. Root squash is a special mapping of the remote superuser (root) identity when using identity authentication.

networkId.description: Network to use to publish the export.

ResetInstanceRequest.description: Message requesting to reset a server.

DisableHyperthreadingRequest.description: Message requesting to perform disable hyperthreading operation on a server.

mountPoints.description: Input only. List of mount points to attach the network to.

reservations.description: List of IP address reservations in this network. When updating this field, an error will be generated if a reservation conflicts with an IP address already allocated to a physical server.

pod.description: Immutable. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Network can only be connected to the assets (instances, nfsshares) allocated in the same pod.

jumboFramesEnabled.description: Whether network uses standard frames or jumbo ones.

servicesCidr.description: IP range for reserved for services (e.g. NFS).

enumDescriptions: Client network, a network peered to a Google Cloud VPC.
Private network, a network local to the Bare Metal Solution environment.

id.description: An identifier for the `Network`, generated by the backend.

vrfAttachment.description: Optional. The name of a pre-existing Vrf that the network should be attached to. Format is `vrfs/{vrf}`.

vrf.description: The Vrf for the Network. Use this only if a new Vrf needs to be created.

name.description: Output only. The resource name of this `Network`. Resource names are schemeless URIs that follow the conventions in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/networks/{network}`

enumDescriptions: The Network is in an unknown state.

vlanId.description: The vlan id of the Network.

userAccounts.description: Map of username to the user account info.

RenameNfsShareRequest.description: Message requesting rename of a server.

newNfsshareId.description: Required. The new `id` of the nfsshare.

ListProvisioningQuotasResponse.description: Response message for the list of provisioning quotas.

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results, or empty if there are no more results in the list.

provisioningQuotas.description: The provisioning quotas registered in this project.

SSHKey.description: An SSH key, used for authorizing with the interactive serial console feature.

publicKey.description: The public SSH key. This must be in OpenSSH .authorized_keys format.

name.description: Output only. The name of this SSH key. Currently, the only valid value for the location is "global".

email.description: Optional. Email provided to send a confirmation with provisioning config to.

EnableHyperthreadingRequest.description: Message requesting to perform enable hyperthreading operation on a server.

ResetInstanceResponse.description: Response message from resetting a server.
